name: How are federal criminal charges different from state charges?

mainEntity.name: How are federal criminal charges different from state charges?

acceptedAnswer.text: Federal criminal charges are prosecuted in U.S. District Courts under federal statutes, often carrying harsher penalties, broader jurisdiction, and complex procedures compared to state-level criminal charges.federalcriminaldefense​
